_comment: Canonical test vectors for the yoink webhook format v1 (docs/WEBHOOK.md). Standard Webhooks signing: base64(HMAC-SHA256(base64decode(secret without whsec_), "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>")). Test-only secrets. Consumed by yoinkTests and by the yoink-relay SDK (vendored copy). manifests: ping response bodies and the destinations yoink reads from them (docs/WEBHOOK.md §3); a destination without a valid group reads as group null.

manifests.name: defaults: mode auto with a description, manual without
unknown mode falls back to suggest
invalid and duplicate destinations are skipped, not the manifest
long texts are cut, blank project names dropped
mode edge cases: null is the default, anything unknown is suggest
cuts count graphemes; trim before cut; caps count valid entries only
empty or blank project lists mean every entry
mode all needs no description; it is never downgraded
groups: same group means only one of them; an invalid group means none, not a skipped destination
